name: gui_material_from_blank
description: MT-1s, from Blank with the GUI only. File > New Project > Blank; Add Object > Cube and a Forward opaque material pass read by present put the grey box on screen (add_primitive_object's path). View > Materials; New material… lists the engine's surfaces (list_surfaces) and proposes a name and a file: OpenPBR's opaque one-sided variant, Create (create_material, registered live). The editor is made from the surface's declaration: base_color's swatch opens the colour dialog, red. The Inspector's Material combo binds the material to every primitive of the cube model (bind_material) and says the material is the model's. Without a restart the box's front is red. specular_roughness's spin reaches the engine; the dock's Undo takes it back, then the red: the document no longer sets base_color and the box is not red.
